title: CALIBER
summary: CALIBER is an interactive web-based platform that translates natural language into SQL, executes queries across DBMSs, and visualizes their energy consumption and CO2 emissions, with a synthetic-data module for generating test datasets. It calls SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer and HMASynthesizer (via sdv.single_table/sdv.multi_table with SingleTableMetadata) to produce privacy-preserving synthetic datasets for testing and development.
evidence: utils/synthetic_generators.py:186 'synthesizer = GaussianCopulaSynthesizer(metadata)'; also CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer, HMASynthesizer calls in same file
